dogecoin.text: @MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs No offense. If you are doing great things, you got all of my respect. It is just the impression I and noticeable others get after such a time. I think my points are sai. Thanks for your feedback and let's hope for a great future.

@MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs I just explicitly said that if a project continues to develop but doesn't release the progress to the users for such a prolonged time of 3 years and because of a reason like ,,better noch touch the running system'' this awakes a feeling of a lack of confidence in your progress.

@RancidPotato @MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs So you are telling me every update in BTC since the last 3 years happened because they needed to update and not because they wanted to get code more efficient or working more fluently? I am not adressing the big decision of Segwit and it's impact here.
@RancidPotato @MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs I would argue letting the majority of users run a 3 year old binary does not really help network stability. Software needs updates.

@RancidPotato @MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs How am I a troll for mentioning that all the progress that the Doge devs are doing isn't bundled in a release since 3 years. And the common binary to download for the users reflects nothing of their effort they put into the dev branches? I am trying to help.

@MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs Also the current release that is offered to download on the projects website offers 1.10 which is from 3 years ago. If doge didn't find the courage to ship a newer version in 3 years just because money is at stake it seem like doge lacks confidence in it's development.

@MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs Sorry when I am on the wrong branch. I just recently hear Richard Heart speaking about exactly this topic. Then I checked the github and saw the last commits and release is a long time ago. Pretty bad for the projects image that the default branch isn't the newest then.
@MSingularity @ummjackson @dogecoin_devs Maybe because you didn't declare a release since 3 years. Just pre-releases. https://t.co/zrqem9oxYQ
